about.title: Built for a more considered workspace.
about.intro: DESKAVYN creates purposeful objects for the rituals that shape focused work.

sections.heading: Our story
sections.body: We believe the desk is more than furniture. It is a daily environment for attention, ideas and momentum, so every DESKAVYN object begins with a practical problem worth solving.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: To make workspaces feel calmer, clearer and more personal through durable design, thoughtful materials and useful details.

sections.heading: Our values
sections.body: Clarity over clutter. Longevity over novelty. Human rituals over empty decoration. We design each product to earn its place over time.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.intro: This policy explains how DESKAVYN handles information shared through this website.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide when you contact us, subscribe to updates, place an order or otherwise interact with our services.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to provide services, respond to requests, improve the store and send communications where you have chosen to receive them.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can request access, correction or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable legal requirements.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern use of the DESKAVYN website and purchases made through it.

sections.heading: Use of this website
sections.body: Use this website lawfully and do not interfere with its operation, security or other visitors' use of it.

sections.heading: Orders and availability
sections.body: Product availability, pricing and delivery estimates may change. We may correct errors before accepting an order where permitted by law.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, contact DESKAVYN using the contact page.

affiliate.title: Share work worth making space for.
affiliate.intro: Our affiliate program is for creators and communities who value thoughtful workspaces.

sections.heading: Program benefits
sections.body: Approved partners receive a unique referral link, product updates and access to launches selected for their audience.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Apply with a short introduction, tell us about your audience, and we will review the fit before sending program details.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.intro: Clear shipping information before your order is placed.

sections.heading: Processing
sections.body: Orders are prepared before dispatch. Processing and dispatch estimates are confirmed during checkout and may vary by product availability.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Delivery times depend on destination, carrier service and customs processing where applicable. Tracking details are sent once an order ships.

sections.heading: International orders
sections.body: International customers may be responsible for local duties, taxes or customs fees assessed by their destination country.

returns.title: Exchanges & Returns
returns.intro: If something is not right, start with a clear return request.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: Return eligibility, time windows and product conditions are confirmed with your order details and applicable local consumer protections.

sections.heading: How to request a return
sections.body: Contact our support team with your order number, the item you need help with and a short description of the issue.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
refund-policy.intro: Refunds are handled after a return or issue has been assessed against the applicable policy.

sections.heading: Refund review
sections.body: Once we receive and inspect an eligible return, we will confirm whether a refund is approved and communicate the next step.

sections.heading: Timing
sections.body: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. Bank or payment-provider processing times can vary.

blogs.title: Designing for deeper focus
blogs.excerpt: A few practical principles for making a desk feel less distracting and more intentional.

body.heading: Reduce decisions
body.body: A useful workspace removes small points of friction. Keep frequently used tools close, and give everything else a deliberate home.

body.heading: Choose fewer, better objects
body.body: The best desk objects support a task without constantly demanding attention. Material, proportion and placement all matter.
